transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before I publish the December holiday on-call roster, I need to run through the holiday-readiness process. I need SRE, payments engineering, customer support, and security to each read back their coverage and flag any exceptions for December 24, 25, and 26. The current draft has Riley as primary and Casey as secondary for all three days, with a 30-minute escalation target. Please go ahead and share your coverage status and any exceptions.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception: my approved leave covers December 25, so I cannot be primary or secondary on-call that day. I confirmed the leave while handling a separate HR scheduling task, but the roster spreadsheet has not been updated to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception for payments engineering. The payments service's enterprise response agreement requires a named payments engineer to acknowledge a production alert within exactly 10 minutes on all three dates — December 24, 25, and 26 — rather than the draft's 30-minute escalation target. I confirmed this clause with account operations this morning, but I have not yet updated the on-call ticket to reflect it.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception for customer support. The customer Meridian has a contractual requirement for a support liaison to contact its administrators during any December 26 production incident, so I, Taylor, must be named as the December 26 customer liaison. I found this in an account-notes review yesterday, but the holiday handoff document still has the default unassigned value.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception for security. A certificate rotation for the production identity service is scheduled for December 26 from 21:00 to 23:00, and it requires me, Jordan, as the security escalation contact and the sole secondary on-call for December 26. I confirmed the timing during a certificate inventory, but the change ticket has not yet been linked to the holiday roster.
